QuestInfo.name: [Heliseum] Trust Matters
QuestInfo.1:
Tonero sees a chance of reclaiming Heliseum, and said doing business with the Nova in support will be good when the Nova retake the capital. Deliver the amplifier from Tonero to #bEdea#k at the #bHeliseum Reclamation HQ#k.

#r#e*If you fail, forfeit the quest and start over from the beginning.#k
QuestInfo.2: Edea was hesitant to do business with the Shadowdealers, but said things may be different after the war now.
